name: Shark
description: A shark is a large, predatory fish known for its streamlined body, formidable jaws, and sharp teeth. It is an apex predator in many marine environments, capable of sensing even the smallest traces of blood in the water and swiftly hunting down its prey.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The shark uses its rows of razor-sharp teeth to bite a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Shred
actions.description: The shark attempts to use it's teeth to create a bleeding wound on a creature, dealing physical damage. If the creature takes damage after mitigations, they gain the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Wound
actions.description: After landing a true hit, the shark attempts to wound a creature. If the creature who was the target of the true hit took damage from the following attack, they must make a resilience check of 7 or gain 1 tier of the wounded condition.

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.description: The shark has an extraordinary sense of smell, especially for blood, allowing it to detect and track wounded creatures from a great distance in the water. The shark has a 1d6 bonus to search checks against creatures with the bleeding condition. Additionally, the shark gains a 2 unit bonus to it's swim speed while a creature is bleeding within 20 units of it.
